cases.prompt: Our branching and release flow is undefined - choose and record a strategy.

assertions: Returns the structured design/decision artifact for this skill and never claims an inspection or execution it did not perform.
Separates verified facts from assumptions and lists open questions.
Names the nearest boundary owners and does not take over their work.

cases.prompt: Decide trunk-based versus release branching for our team and record the trade-offs.

assertions: Produces the primary artifact from inspected evidence rather than a template fill.
Calls out the conflicting constraints and states the trade-off explicitly.
Keeps UNKNOWN/UNVERIFIED items out of the decision record.

cases.prompt: Design branch naming, protection and review rules with a migration path.

assertions: Enumerates edge/failure cases with a chosen handling rather than hand-waving them.
Defines the validation/test plan that would prove the artifact.
Does not claim to have run or implemented anything.

cases.prompt: Ci pipeline architect work: handle the deliverable end-to-end for our system.

assertions: Routes the request to the real neighbouring owner named in the prompt.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: Our hotfix flow during release freeze is unclear - design the branching decision record.

assertions: Handles the incomplete/conflicting input by stating explicit open questions.
Lists the evidence needed before the record can be treated as a decision.
Returns the artifact with UNKNOWN/UNVERIFIED labels instead of invented facts.

cases.prompt: We are moving to trunk-based - record the rules, merge strategy and migration risks.

assertions: Refuses to assume facts or skip a required safety/evidence step.
States what is missing and what the authorized human owner must provide.
Does not claim to have run or implemented anything.
